comments.text:
Please understand this, the purpose of insurance is to help you in the rough phase of your life. Niva people offers so many benefits on the papers but when it comes to giving out claims, they will harass you to such an extent, you will leave following up your claim.

I have 4 year old Health insurance policy. I applied for a reimbursement after filing the claim. Submitted all the necessary documents, and extra documents they asked. But after so many calls and emails they approved only 26% of the claim citing vague reason of reasonable and customary clause. I asked the rate card and how have you decided the same? No concrete answer, just they will try to fool you by giving some service number and will tell you to wait for another 2 weeks, and repeat.

The biggest problem with Niva is that, you just can not talk to a responsible person as a customer. You’ll get connected to  customer service, they don’t have any idea about the case and they don’t have any power to take any decisions. They are just trained to give you a false promise, and a service number.

Every time you call, you have to send the documents again, as there is no centralised storage. Even people from medical team, can’t take the decisions. 

They are always looking for a loophole to reject your claim, so many documents, so many emails,calls but in the end they will give you a bad experience and lesson. 

No matter how much the policy appears good on the paper, it’s not always in reality. Before choosing any policy, discuss with your relatives, colleagues and friends about their experiences and then only decide.

Choose a company with good ICR( incurred claim ratio) simply is the ratio of, for every 100 Rs you collect in premium, how much you give back in claims. For Niva it is around 55-60. 
It is too low. This shows, they are very stringent in approving claims. 

For comparison, HDFC has ICR of HDFC ERGO is about 75.
The possible reason might be HDFC has many sources of income, where as NIVA has only one i.e. health insurance.

In short, choose the insurance wisely. Don’t go for on paper features, they might be on paper only. Take reviews from the people about claim settlement. Then decide
